title: Name a number
summary: PL/SQL: Name a number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: DECLARE introduces local values. := assigns a value. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Name a number

blocks.text: DECLARE gives pencils the value 3. PUT_LINE prints its sum with 2.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Assignment uses :=, while = is a comparison.
